$comment: chwezi-slop rule registry (M10-09-T01). Data rows keyed to the K5 AS1-AS7 overlay. Enforces Chwezi doctrine, not Impeccable's: Impeccable rule ideas and thresholds are adapted in paraphrase with attribution (Apache-2.0, commit 114ea1d) and its font lists are ban evidence only. Validate with: node tools/slop-detector/cli.mjs --validate-registry

rules.name: Banned AI-slop font as primary type

authority.human_authority: Chwezi font doctrine: doctrine/references/ai-slop-banned-fonts.md (approvals trace to human design authority per pairing-principles.md)
authority.house_ruling: Peter Bamuhigire, house rulings of 21 Jun 2026 and 29 Sep 2026 (Fraunces, IBM Plex); watchlist refresh 29 Sep 2026

rules.provenance: Chwezi doctrine read from doctrine/references/ai-slop-banned-fonts.json through hooks/lib/font-matcher.js (shared with banned-font-gate.js). Impeccable list used as ban evidence only (Apache-2.0, commit 114ea1d).
exceptions: banned face named only as a fallback
client brand guideline recorded as a waiver
deliberate documented system-font fallback chain (system-font-fallbacks.md)
